# #3696: Patch: the AI's search keeps room for a plan whose payoff lands next turn
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Some cards pay off a turn later: a supply drop that arrives next turn, or Mind Games, whose secret reward lands at the start of your next turn. The practice AI thinks through the opponent's answer for only a handful of its best-looking plans, and it picks that handful by a quick score that cannot see a payoff still to come. So "cast Mind Games and end the turn" looks like throwing two mana away, and it is cut before the AI ever weighs it. Once this is built, the AI always keeps one place in that handful for its best plan with a payoff still to come, and the opponent it imagines answers such cards as a person would.

## Why
- Only the top `finalists × lines_per_action` lines (3 × 2 = 6; `crates/ai/src/config.rs:66`, `:222`), ranked by the static score, reach the opponent's reply (`shortlist_lines`, `crates/ai/src/decide.rs:133-152`, called at `decide.rs:542`).
- The static evaluation (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `material`) prices almost none of the seat's own delayed effects. Countdowns are fired only inside the reply's score (`crates/ai/src/reply.rs:593-600`, #1995). A line whose value is a delayed reward therefore ranks on its cost alone, and one unit play tried in five lanes fills the six places first.
- The sweep of 2026-10-28 (`training/history/sweep-2026-10-28.md:220-243`): Jlockeed's Supply Drop was cast on 25 of 619 affordable turns at Hard and 53 of 417 at Easy, at a mean evaluation change of about −1.4 to −2.6; Mind Games on 12 of 470 at Hard and 46 of 351 at Easy, about −1.6 to −3.1. `the_ai_casts_supply_drop_in_combat_mode_against_three_3_health_units` (`crates/ai/tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs:342`) passes only because Supply Drop is the AI's only card there.
- Once Mind Games does reach the reply, the imagined opponent never plays its Fortify Mind. `best_try` (`reply.rs:284-319`) compares each play with the position now, where a winning guess changes nothing the evaluation reads (the reward it cancels is a delayed entry). So the opponent keeps the card, and cleanup discards it into all three penalties (`crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c022_1_fortify_mind.rs`, R862). Fixing the shortlist alone would make the AI overrate Mind Games.

## Proposal
1. `shortlist_lines` keeps one place for the best-scored line whose end holds a delayed entry of the seat's own that the root did not (a countdown or a next-turn reward), when the plain ranking left none in. That is at most one more reply a decision.
2. In the reply, an opponent holding a known Temporary card that cleanup will discard this turn compares its plays with the position after its turn ends, not before. A guess against the AI's secret is drawn from the world's own stream, so it never depends on the secret (R185, R860).

## Where it lands
- `crates/ai/src/decide.rs`, `crates/ai/src/reply.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/secrets.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/reply.rs`
- SPEC §10.7; R185, R860, R861, R862, R864

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A `shortlist_lines` test: the best delayed-payoff line is kept when six other lines outscore it, and no place is held back when there is no such line or one already made the cut.
- [ ] A decision test: the Supply Drop board of `meditative_plus.rs:342`, with a castable unit added to the AI's hand, still casts Supply Drop in combat mode.
- [ ] A reply test: after the AI casts Mind Games, the imagined opponent plays Fortify Mind rather than letting it be discarded, and its guess is the same whichever choice the AI kept secret.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` passes and `cargo jackioh perf` stays within its budgets; the sweep rows for Supply Drop and Mind Games, before and after, are in the pull request.

## Size and risks
Small to medium: two functions and four tests. One more reply a decision costs time on a slow phone; the perf gate measures it, and the extra place can be skipped when the clock is short. Casting these cards more often may not win more games; the gate decides, and a version that loses there does not ship.

## Goal

1. `shortlist_lines` keeps one extra place for the best line whose end holds a delayed entry of the seat's own that the root did not. It does so only when the plain ranking left no such line in. So Supply Drop and Mind Games reach the opponent's reply.

- A Supply Drop decision test.
- A Mind Games / Fortify Mind reply test.

5. **`decide.rs` fix.**
   - Signature: `fn shortlist_lines<'a>(found: &'a [Line], count: usize, root: &GameState, seat: PlayerId) -> Vec<&'a Line>`.
   - After the existing loop, before `out`:
     ```rust
     let waits = |line: &Line| {
         matches!(line.status, LineStatus::Passed | LineStatus::Yielded)
             && line.end.delayed.iter().any(|entry| {
                 entry.owner == seat && !root.delayed.iter().any(|held| held.id == entry.id)
             })
     };

         && let Some(extra) = found.iter().find(|line| waits(line))

     }
     ```
   - `found` is sorted best-first (`best_first_lines`), so `find` takes the best-scored line. The extra goes last, so `plan`'s `reply_score ... else { break }` skips it first when nodes run short.

6. **`reply.rs` fix.**
   - Imports: add `Rng, SECRET_KEY, card_keywords, secret_of, temporary_number` to the `jackioh_engine::{…}` list, then run `cargo fmt`.
   - Add above `known_play`:
     ```rust
     /// R3696001: the stream a guess against a secret is drawn on, beside the world's seed and the card.
     const GUESS_SEED: &str = "ai:guess";

     fn doomed_known_card(state: &GameState, opp: PlayerId, hidden: &IndexSet<String>) -> bool {
         state.players[opp].hand.iter().any(|card| {
             !hidden.contains(&card.id)
                 && temporary_number(&card_keywords(state, card)).is_some_and(|left| left <= 1)
         })
     }

     fn guesses_secret(state: &GameState, seat: PlayerId, instance_id: &str) -> bool {
         find_instance(state, instance_id)
             .and_then(|card| card.memory.get(SECRET_KEY))
             .and_then(|link| link.as_str())
             .and_then(|id| secret_of(state, id))
             .is_some_and(|secret| secret.owner == seat && secret.revealed != Some(true))
     }

     fn one_guess_per_card(state: &GameState, seat: PlayerId, plays: Vec<ActionBody>) -> Vec<ActionBody> {
         let card_of = |play: &ActionBody| match play {
             ActionBody::Play { instance_id, .. } if guesses_secret(state, seat, instance_id) => {
                 Some(instance_id.clone())
             }
             _ => None,
         };
         let mut out: Vec<ActionBody> = Vec::with_capacity(plays.len());
         let mut settled: IndexSet<String> = IndexSet::new();
         for play in &plays {
             let Some(card) = card_of(play) else { out.push(play.clone()); continue };
             if !settled.insert(card.clone()) { continue }
             let guesses: Vec<&ActionBody> = plays.iter()
                 .filter(|other| card_of(other).as_deref() == Some(card.as_str())).collect();
             let stream = format!("{GUESS_SEED}:{}:{card}", state.seed);
             out.push(Rng::new(&stream, 0).pick(&guesses).copied().unwrap_or(play).clone());
         }
         out
     }
     ```
   - `known_play`: filter the plays as now with no `.take`. Then `let plays: Vec<ActionBody> = one_guess_per_card(state, seat, plays).into_iter().take(AI_REPLY.known_plays.max(0) as usize).collect();`. Then `best_try(state, opp, &plays, doomed_known_card(state, opp, hidden), counter, prices)`.
   - Add `fn judged(state, opp, at_close: bool, counter: &dyn NodeCounter, prices) -> Option<f64>`:

   - `best_try` gets `at_close: bool` before `counter`. Its baseline becomes `let Some(mut best_value) = judged(state, opp, at_close, counter, prices) else { return Known::Cut };`. Each try's value becomes `let Some(value) = judged(&next, opp, at_close, counter, prices) else { return Known::Cut };`. The immediate-win return stays on `next`.
   - The two other callers (`visible_activation`, `defense_switch`) pass `false`.
   - Update the doc comments of `known_play` and `best_try`, and the file header's "Rule order" item 1, to say this.

Edit only that bullet.

## Tests

All in `crates/ai`.

`src/decide.rs`, run with `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --lib r3696000`:
- `r3696000_the_best_delayed_payoff_line_keeps_a_place_after_the_six_that_outscore_it`
  - Lines 6 and 7 hold new `AI` entries "d9" and "d10".
  - `shortlist_lines(&lines, 6, &root, AI)` has scores `[10,9,8,7,6,5,4]`: line 6 only.
- `r3696000_no_place_is_held_back_without_a_delayed_payoff_line`: no entries, scores `[10..5]`.
- `r3696000_no_place_is_held_back_when_a_delayed_payoff_line_made_the_cut`
  - Entries on lines 1 and 6.
  - Result is six lines, none added.
- `r3696000_an_entry_the_root_held_the_other_seat_owns_or_a_line_never_replied_to_is_no_payoff`
  - The root holds "d1" for `AI`; line 6 ends with `HUMAN`'s "d2" and line 7 with an `AI` "d3" at `LineStatus::Over`.
  - Result is 6 lines.
  - Set `lines[7].status = LineStatus::Yielded` and the result is 7.

`src/reply.rs`, run with `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --lib r3696001`:
- `r3696001_the_opponent_plays_the_fortify_mind_it_would_otherwise_discard`, for `kept` in greed, attack, defend:
  - `known_play(s.state(), P1, &legal_actions(s.state(), P2), &hidden, &create_node_counter(200, None), Prices::NONE)` is `Known::Played(next)` with the Fortify id (`s.card(FORTIFY).id`) gone from `next.players[P2].hand`.
  - `best_try(s.state(), P2, &one_guess_per_card(..), false, &counter, Prices::NONE)` is `Known::Nothing`. That is the old behaviour, which pins what the fix changes.
- `r3696001_the_guess_is_the_same_whichever_choice_the_ai_kept_secret`
  - For the three `kept` choices, `fortify_plays` has 3 variants (one per guess).
  - The `one_guess_per_card` result has 1 play and is equal across the three.
- `r3696001_a_revealed_secret_is_guessed_by_evaluation_and_worlds_draw_different_guesses`
  - Set `secret.revealed = Some(true)` on a clone: all 3 variants stay.
  - On the unrevealed state, set `state.seed` to `w0` to `w29` via `s.state_mut().seed = …`. The picked `modes` take more than one distinct value.

`tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs`: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai the_ai_still_casts_supply_drop`.

## Done when

- [ ] The extra shortlist place exists, last in order, once, and only for a new own entry on a `Passed`/`Yielded` line (4 tests).
- [ ] The two-Vanilla Supply Drop test was red before step 5 and is green after.
- [ ] A known doomed Temporary card makes the opponent compare at turn end; the Fortify Mind is played; its guess is secret-independent (3 tests).
- [ ] R3696000, R3696001, `spec/pending/3696.md`, `spec/09-architecture.md` and `crates/ai/README.md` are written; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --lib --test ai`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` pass; `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` is empty.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh catalog check` and `cargo jackioh patches check` pass.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` and `cargo jackioh perf` are run and their output is reported as it came. A gate loss means the version does not ship. Say so; do not adjust the gate.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` is run if `origin/main` exists. No card changes, so no patch fragment.

## Risks

- **Determinism and replay.** Both new draws are pure. `GUESS_SEED:<seed>:<card>` at cursor 0 does not move the world's cursor, and the shortlist adds no draw. Crate purity (rule 4) is kept: no new dependency, clock or collection.
- **Hidden information (R185).** The shortlist reads only the AI's own delayed entries. The guess is picked before any evaluation, so two states differing only in the AI's secret choice pick the same guess; the test pins this. `guesses_secret` applies only to a secret owned by the seat and not yet revealed. After a reveal the choice is public and evaluation may pick the guess.
- **Cost.** At most one more reply per decision, placed last, so a short clock drops it first. `doomed_known_card` adds 1 + n `EndTurn` simulations per `known_play` step, only while such a card is held. `reserve` in `plan` is deliberately unchanged: raising it would shrink every beam by 5 nodes. On fat boards the extra reply may be cut; `cargo jackioh perf` measures the cost.
- **Rejected alternatives.**
  - Respecting `lines_per_action` for the extra line: it could never add a line whose first action is already capped.
  - Putting the extra line first.
  - Closing the comparison for every `best_try` call: only the doomed-card case changes behaviour.
  - Collapsing every modal play's variants: only guesses against a live unrevealed secret are collapsed.
- **Strength.** Casting these cards more often may not win more games; the gate decides.

## Open questions

- The acceptance item "the sweep rows for Supply Drop and Mind Games, before and after, are in the pull request" needs `cargo jackioh sweep` runs on `main` and on the branch. These are long, so the builder may not finish them. If it cannot run them, a person or the daily job should add the rows. The builder must not invent them.
